paragraphs: R' Rahmai. R' Pinhas regularly attended him on the shore of the Sea of Gennesaret. He was old and full of days, and his eyes had grown dim. In the Zohar he is called R' Rehumai, and his eyes had ceased to see. He told R' Pinhas, ‘I heard that our colleague Yohai has a pearl, a precious stone,’ etc. Heilprin takes this as a hint to R' Shimon and his son R' Elazar. See Zohar, Introduction 20:185–186 [Heilprin’s locator על״ו remains unresolved].
